issues.statement: The added examine-in-light desklamp section produced no behavior distinguishable from the un-edited Parent in the observed examine pairs.
issues.reason: This is contradicted by train:0002, an examine/look-at-cd-under-desklamp pair in the supplied records. The cd was taken from desk 1, which showed no desklamp (P3:2/P3:4 observation lists only alarmclock, cd, keychain), and the Parent and Candidate did not behave the same: the Parent returned to the acquisition location desk 1 at P3:5 between shelf 1 (P3:4) and shelf 2 (P3:6) before using the desklamp (P3:7), while the Candidate went from shelf 1 (Q3:4) directly to shelf 2 (Q3:5) and used the desklamp (Q3:6) — 7 vs 6 actions. The diff's examine-in-light section contains the explicit clause against returning to the desklamp-less acquisition location, and the sibling knowledge for this same pair attributes the difference to that added examine-specific guidance, so the claim that the section produced no distinguishable behavior is factually wrong.
